description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the keyword expansion rule. When fetching AI news, it must NOT use bare '--keyword AI' but instead expand to the full domain set: 'AI,LLM,GPT,Claude,Generative,Machine Learning,RAG,Agent'.
2. Agent calls 'python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source hackernews --limit N --keyword "AI,LLM,GPT,Claude,Generative,Machine Learning,RAG,Agent" --deep' — noting the mandatory --deep flag.
3. Agent calls 'python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source github --limit 10 --deep' for GitHub Trending.
4. Agent receives the JSON output and discovers only 2 HN items fall within the 3-hour window (IDs 40001, 40002). Since this is < 5 items, the SKILL.md Smart Fill rule triggers: agent must add older high-heat items (IDs 40003, 40004, 40005) and annotate them clearly with ⚠️ or 🔥 markers.
5. For GitHub Trending, agent must NOT apply Smart Fill (GitHub Trending Exception), but MUST list ALL 5 fetched repos. For EACH repo, agent produces '核心价值', '启发思考', and '场景标签' deep analysis sections.
6. All item titles in the report must be Markdown links: [Title](URL) — not plain text.
7. Each item must have a metadata line with Source, Time/Date, and Heat/Score.
8. The report must have Global Headlines section and Tech & AI section structure.
9. The full report must be saved to reports/hn_news_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.md (timestamped filename in reports/ directory).
10. The entire report must be written in Simplified Chinese (简体中文).
